jobs.tierReason: security review of the orchestrator-mode shell guard that gates every shell command of the owner's coding sessions
jobs.prompt: Static security review of coordination/review/omode-guard.diff (orchestrator mode: deny-by-default shell allowlist in tools/shell-writes.mjs, hook in tools/handbuild-guard.mjs and tools/orchestrator-hook.mjs, tools/handbuild.mjs). Promises: in orchestrator mode only the listed read and swarm commands run; no wrappers, env, absolute-path binaries, compound commands, substitution or redirects; git commit, git push, gh pr create and gh pr merge are always refused; the guard fails closed on crash, timeout or oversized input (parent/child with hard spawnSync timeout), the tokenizer is linear, the recorder hook cannot stall for more than 2 s; the off switches cannot be written from inside orchestrator mode; orchestratorModeEnabled must not become fail-open (check the new requirement of a .swarm directory: can a session reach a state where orchestrator mode is silently off in a real swarm project, or be turned off by creating or removing a directory?). Report only real bypasses or fail-open paths with a concrete command or state, ranked, with a verdict PASS or FAIL.
